# MultiLinkQR

> MultiLinkQR (https://www.multilinkqr.com) is a free, browser-based QR code generator that puts multiple links into one QR code. When someone scans the code, a landing page shows all the links as buttons (or tries to open them all). It also creates simple single-link QR codes. No account, no sign-up and no watermark. Downloads are PNG or SVG.

Key facts:
- Price: free. No account or sign-up needed.
- Multi-link QR codes: add any number of HTTPS links with labels (for example Instagram, WhatsApp, website, menu, Google Form).
- Customization: QR color, background, border, rounded style, center logo, expiry date, optional UTM tags per link.
- Open mode: "show buttons" or "auto-open all links".
- Privacy: the QR code's data (title, style, links) is encoded in the link itself; MultiLinkQR does not store it in a database.
- QR codes are static: to change the links, generate and print a new code.
- Works on any modern phone camera or QR scanner app.

## Main pages

- [Multi-link QR code generator](https://www.multilinkqr.com/): create a QR code for multiple links (the tool is on the homepage)
- [FAQ](https://www.multilinkqr.com/faq.html): common questions about creating, printing and troubleshooting multi-link QR codes
- [QR code tips](https://www.multilinkqr.com/tips.html): practical tips for business cards, menus, portfolios and events
- [About](https://www.multilinkqr.com/about.html): how MultiLinkQR works and who it is for
